-nochat: skip groups
-user: include users
-copy: send as copy
-silent: no notification sound
-assistant: send from assistants to groups they joined
-nobot: skip the bot (assistant-only)
-pin / -pinloud: pin in groups

help_menu: Click the buttons below to get information about my commands. Note: All commands can be used with /
help_admins: Admin commands: /pause: Puase the ongoing stream. /resume: Resume the paused stream. /skip: Skip the current stream. /stop: Stop the ongoing stream. /seek [duration in seconds]: Seek the ongoing stream. /seekback [duration in seconds]: Seek the ongoing stream backward. /reload: Reloads the admin cache.
help_auth: Auth commands: Authorized users can control the ongoing stream without being an admin. /auth: Add a user to the authorized users list. /unauth: Remove a user from the authorized users list.
help_blist: Blacklist commands: Blacklisted chats and users cannot use the bot. /blacklist [chat_id|user_id]: Add a chat/user to the blacklist. /unblacklist [chat_id|user_id]: Remove a chat/user from the blacklist
help_lang: Language commands: This bot supports multiple languages. /lang: Change the language of the bot.
help_ping: Ping commands: /help: Shows the help menu of the bot. /ping: Check the ping and memory usage of the bot. /start: Start the bot. /sudolist: Shows the list of sudo users of the bot.
help_play: Play commands: You can play music in the video chat using the following commands. /play [song name/youtube url/reply to audio]: Play music in the video chat. /vplay [song name/youtube url/reply to video]: Play music video in the video chat. -f: Force play music in the video chat. -v: Plays music video in the video chat. Example: /play -f -v attention
help_queue: Queue commands: /queue: Shows the currently queued tracks in the queue.
help_autoplay: Autoplay commands: /autoplay [enable|disable]: Toggles the autoplay on/off for the chat.
autoplay_on: Autoplay enabled by {0} From now on, the bot will automatically play related music once the queue is empty.
help_vclog: VC Logger commands: /vclogger: Toggles the VC join/leave logger on/off for the chat.
help_sudo: Sudo commands: /ac: Shows the active calls count. /activevc: Shows the list of the active calls. /broadcast [reply to message]: Broadcasts the message to all the chats. -nochat: Excludes groups from the broadcast. -user: Include users in the broadcast. -copy: Removes the forwarded tag from the broadcast message. -silent: Send without notification sound. -assistant: Send from assistants to groups they joined. -nobot: Skip the bot (assistant-only). -pin / -pinloud: Pin in groups. Example: /broadcast -user -copy -assistant -silent /eval: Executes the given code. /logs: Sends the log file. /logger [on|off]: Enables/disables the logger. /restart: Restarts the bot. /addsudo: Add a user to the sudo users list. /rmsudo: Remove a user from the sudo users list.

welcome_instr: ➻ Set welcome message Reply to a message or pass text with /setwelcome. you can use html and: • {id} = user id • {name} = user name • {surname} = user surname • {namesurname} = name and surname • {lang} = user language • {date} = current date • {time} = current time • {weekday} = week day • {mention} = link to the user profile • {username} = username • {groupname} = group name • {rules} = group regulation Buttons (via /setwelcomebutton), one row per line: Rules - https://t.me/link | Support - https://t.me/link Media: reply a photo/video with /setwelcomemedia. Toggle: /welcometoggle [on|off] · Reset: /resetwelcome
welcome_media_usage: Reply to a photo/video/GIF with /setwelcomemedia, or /setwelcomemedia off to clear.
welcome_button_usage: Send button spec with /setwelcomebutton, one row per line: Text - https://url | Text - https://url Use /setwelcomebutton off to clear.

help_clone: Clone commands: Run your own bot under this bot's engine. Main bot (private chat): /clone <token>: Start your own clone bot. Get the token from @BotFather. /delclone <token>: Stop and delete your clone. /myclone: Show your clones and their status. On your own clone (owner only): /setstart: Reply to a photo/video/GIF to set custom start media (or add text for the start message). /delstart: Remove custom start media. /setstartmsg <text>: Set the start message text. /setpingpic: Reply to media to set custom ping media. /setstatspic: Reply to media to set custom stats media. /name <new name>: Change your clone's display name. /setchannel <link>: Set the channel button on start. /setchannelname <name>: Set the channel button name. /delchannelname: Remove the custom channel button name. /setsupport <link>: Set the support button on start. /setsupportname <name>: Set the support button name. /delsupportname: Remove the custom support button name. /setownername <name>: Set the owner button name. /delownername: Remove the custom owner button name. /enhelpbtn | /dishelpbtn: Show or hide the help button. /enclonebtn | /disclonebtn: Show or hide the add me button. /ensupportbtn | /dissupportbtn: Show or hide the support button. /enchannelbtn | /dischannelbtn: Show or hide the channel button. /enownerbtn | /disownerbtn: Show or hide the owner button. /enlangbtn | /dislangbtn: Show or hide the language button. /addbtn <name> <link>: Add a custom /start button. /delbtn <name>: Remove a custom /start button. /clearbtns: Remove all custom /start buttons. /setstring <session>: Run the clone on its own assistants. /delstring: Go back to shared assistants. /setlogger <chat_id>: Set a per-clone log channel. /chatbot: Toggle the AI chatbot. /restart: Restart your clone.
